name: funground
description: Run a funground sketch beside the editor, in github.dev, vscode.dev and VS Code.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Sketches run only in the preview panel's own sandboxed origin, never with the editor's rights.

funground.autoRun.description: Run the sketch again a moment after you stop typing (and whenever you save).

funground.autoRunDelay.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last change before running again.

funground.runtimeUrl.description: Where Python and funground load from. If this is empty, the copy inside the extension is used when the extension has one; otherwise the funground website (https://funground-hq.github.io/runtime/, in the folder for the version this extension was made for). Set it to another folder (https://.../) holding pyodide/ and runtime/, served with CORS, to load from there instead.

funground.randomSeed.description: Seed the random numbers before each run, so every run draws the same (as funground's tests do). Empty: different each run.
